basics.name: Alex Rivera
basics.label: Senior Backend Engineer
basics.tagline: Backend systems that stay boring under load
basics.summary: Backend engineer with six years building and operating API services for small teams, most recently focused on payment reliability and on-call sanity.

work.name: Fictional Payments Co.
work.description: Payment processing platform for small merchants.

highlights.summary: Rebuilt the payment-retry path so duplicate submissions could no longer double-charge a merchant

specifics.detail: Designed an idempotency-key table with a unique constraint enforced at the database
Migrated the existing retry queue over a weekend with no downtime

highlights.story: A merchant lost a day's revenue to a double-charge bug the week before I joined; fixing the class of bug, not the instance, was the first thing I asked to own.

work.name: Example Logistics
work.description: Route-planning software for regional delivery fleets.

highlights.summary: Cut route-recalculation latency by adding a bounded cache in front of the routing service

specifics.detail: Profiled the recalculation path and found 80% of requests repeated within a five-minute window
Added a size-bounded LRU cache with a correctness fallback on miss

metrics.basis: internal load test, matched to production traffic shape

projects.name: example-webhook-relay
projects.description: A small open-source relay for replaying webhooks during local development.

highlights.summary: Built a local relay that replays production webhooks against a dev server

specifics.detail: Implemented signature verification matching the upstream provider's HMAC scheme

metrics.amount: cut from about 30 minutes to under a minute

projects.name: example-status-page
projects.description: A minimal static status-page generator, published as a starter template.

highlights.summary: Published a starter template for a static status page with zero runtime dependencies
highlights.story: Wrote this after maintaining a heavier status-page tool at a previous job; kept this one deliberately boring.

narrative.careerArc: Started in general backend work, narrowed toward systems where correctness under retry and failure matters more than feature velocity.
narrative.currentStatus: Looking for the next role after two years stabilizing a payments platform.
narrative.motivation: Prefers small teams where one engineer can own a system end to end.
narrative.lookingFor: Backend or platform roles with real operational ownership.
narrative.avoiding: Pure feature-factory roles with no on-call ownership.
narrative.workingStyle: Writes the failure mode down before writing the happy path.
narrative.strengths: Debugging distributed failures under time pressure.
narrative.voice: Direct, understated, prefers specifics over adjectives.
